name: PlatformTableCellResizableDirective
description: Tracks mouse movement over the cell if the mouse pointer near the side of the cell, informs resize service.

inputs.name: activable
inputs.description: Whether the table cell is activable

inputs.name: cellFocusedEventAnnouncer
inputs.description: Function, which returns a string to be announced by screen-reader whenever an item which is in grid receives focus.

inputs.name: fitContent
inputs.description: Whether the table cell's width should fit to content

inputs.name: focusable
inputs.description:
Whether the table cell is focusable.
This input syncs with the parent FocusableItemDirective's focusable state.

inputs.name: hoverable
inputs.description: Whether the table cell is hoverable

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Key of a cell element, it's used to identify this cell with certain column

inputs.name: noBorderX
inputs.description: Whether to show the table cell's horizontal borders

inputs.name: noBorderY
inputs.description: Whether to show the table cell's vertical borders

inputs.name: noData
inputs.description: Whether the table cell indicates that there is no data

inputs.name: noPadding
inputs.description: Whether the table cell shouldn't have padding on sides

inputs.name: nonInteractive
inputs.description: Whether the table cell inside table header should be non-interactive

inputs.name: role
inputs.description: ARIA role for the table cell (only used if explicitly provided)

methods.name: setFocusable
methods.description:
Programmatically set the _focusable state.
This allows parent components to update the _focusable state.
